crossRefs.note: Blessed are you by Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

translations.bsb: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

translations.asv: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth. Psalm 125 A Song of Ascents.
